verdict.rationale: YYLO is a developer-oriented CLI that orchestrates coding agents. It can turn a described task into receipt-backed repository changes, loop until kanban work is complete, and pull GitHub issues or Slack messages into kanban and report completion back. That gives a non-engineer an indirect route to agent-driven implementation. However, nothing in the evidence covers taking a mockup or design file as input, and the product is explicitly aimed at developers and project operators working through Git and the CLI. Missing for 10: mockup/design ingestion or design-to-code capability, a non-engineer (PM) friendly workflow, any hands-on evidence of a working implementation produced without engineering involvement.
